info.title: NARRATE Blueprint Unified API
info.description: Unified ontology-driven API contract for the NARRATE Blueprint ecosystem.

post.description: Executes ontology-guided semantic queries across Blueprint entities and relationships.

get.summary: Get full multi-valued details for individual

hasCustomerID.description: Unique identifier or code for the customer

hasScheduledDelivery.description: Associates a Customer with a DeliverySchedule that defines planned or scheduled delivery activities related to customer orders or manufactured products.

placesOrder.description: Links a Customer to one or more SalesOrder entities representing commercial orders placed for requested products or manufactured goods.

hasCountry.description: Country where the supplier is based

hasStartDate.description: Date when the supplier relationship started

hasSupplierType.description: Defines an operational or business classification associated with the Supplier, such as logistics provider, maintenance provider, energy supplier, or service provider. This property complements the supplier hierarchy and supports organizational categorization and filtering.

locatedAt.description: Geographical location of the supplier (if you model Location as a class)

suppliesComponent.description: Associates a ComponentSupplier with one or more OutsourcedComponent entities that are externally supplied for use in manufacturing, assembly, or production operations.

hasEmbeddedCarbonFootprint.description: Component-level carbon footprint (kg CO₂e per unit). Aggregated from material sustainability

hasSurfaceTreatmentImpact.description: Environmental impact of coatings, paints, or finishes. Relevant for wooden/metal components

hasComponentSustainabilityID.description: Unique identifier for the component sustainability record

hasSustainCertification.description: Sustainability or traceability certification reference, for example FSC-C123456

receivesDataFrom.description: InverseOf reportsToSustainability: Indicates that the environmental sensor provides environmental monitoring data used by the SustainabilityBlueprint for sustainability analysis and environmental impact assessment.

aggregatesMaterialSustainability.description: ComponentSustainabilty aggregates all involved material sustainability metrics

affectsProcess.description: Indicates the production process whose performance or execution is impacted by the event

prodEventTriggeredBy.description: Invesre of triggersProductionEvent: Connects observation to derived Event. This is where external reasoning may instantiate Event instances.

occursDuringExecution.description: Associates the event with the specific execution instance of a production process.

isReferencedByMBOM.description: Associates a ProductionProcess with one or more MBOM entities that reference the process as part of the manufacturing structure, operational workflow, or production realization definition

processIsExecutedBy.description: Associates a ProductionProcess with one or more ProcessExecution entities representing runtime executions or operational instances of the manufacturing process.

consumesManufacturedComponent.description: Associates a ProductionProcess with ManufacturedComponent entities that are consumed, transformed, assembled, or used as inputs during manufacturing operations.

isEvaluatedByEnergyKPI.description:
The object property isEvaluatedByEnergyKPI indicates that a ProductionProcess is assessed by one or more EnergyKPI instances.

It provides a reverse navigational link, allowing processes to be queried based on the KPIs that evaluate their performance.

isPerformedAtStation.description: Associates a ProductionProcess with one or more Station entities where the manufacturing process can be operationally performed, executed, or supported within the production environment.

isEvaluatedByWasteKPI.description: Indicates that a ProductionProcess is assessed by a WasteKPI, providing waste-related performance measurements for that process.

monitoredByProductionSensor.description: InverseOf monitorsProcess: Indicates the production process whose performance is monitored by the sensor. Enables linking observed production metrics with the relevant process.

producesManufacturedComponent.description: Production Process produces a component/semi-finished product

isEvaluatedByWaterKPI.description: Indicates that a ProductionProcess is assessed by a WaterKPI, providing water-related performance measurements for that process.

hasMetric.description: Invesre of metricOfProcess: Indicates the production process whose performance is evaluated using this metric.

affectedByEvent.description: Inverse of affectsProcess: Indicates the production process whose performance or execution is impacted by the event

isOrganizedByPlan.description: Indicates that a ProductionProcess is coordinated or scheduled within a ProductionPlan. Associates a ProductionProcess with one or more ProductionPlan entities in which the process is scheduled, coordinated, sequenced, or operationally organized for manufacturing activities.

includesExecution.description: Associates a WorkOrder with one or more ProcessExecution entities performed as part of the manufacturing operations governed by the work order. Associates a WorkOrder with one or more ProcessExecution entities representing runtime manufacturing executions coordinated, scheduled, or managed under the work order.

isGeneratedBy.description: Which SalesOrder generates this WorkOrder. 1 sales order is mapped to many WorkOrder  for each prodiuct in the SalesOrder

assignedToOperator.description: Person assigned to execute the work

isGovernedBySLA.description: Inverse of:SLA applied on production request

workOrderCreatedBy.description: Associates a WorkOrder with the Employee responsible for creating, initiating, or registering the work order within the manufacturing or production management system.

appliesToProduct.description: This WorkOrder applies to  which Product Instance(s)

isOrgainzedByPlan.description: Indicates that a WorkOrder is coordinated and scheduled within a ProductionPlan. Associates a WorkOrder with a ProductionPlan that coordinates, schedules, and organizes the execution of manufacturing operations associated with the work order.

parameterID.description: Unique identifier for the measurable parameter used to ensure traceability and consistent reference across sensors, observations, and analytics tools.

parameterName.description: Human-readable name describing the measured parameter (e.g., Temperature, CycleTime, EnergyConsumption).

parameterDescription.description: Optional textual description explaining the meaning and role of the parameter within the manufacturing system.

unitOfMeasurement.description: Specifies the measurement unit associated with the parameter (e.g., °C, mm/s, seconds, kWh). This helps interpret observed values generated by sensors.

logisticsParamMonitoredBy.description: inverse of monitorsLogisticsParam: Specifies which measurable property is being observed (e.g., CycleTime, Temperature).

hasCreationDate.description: Date and time when the MBOM was created.

hasEffectiveDate.description: Date when this MBOM becomes valid for production.

hasMBOMApprovalDate.description: when the MBOM was formally approved.

hasRevisionNote.description: Optional short note summarizing the reason for revision. For example: Adjusted material substitute for FrameAssembly

hasMBOMVersion.description: MBOM version number or label (used to track revisions).

referencesProcess.description: Associates an MBOM with one or more ProductionProcess entities required to manufacture, assemble, transform, or operationally realize the manufacturing-oriented bill of materials.

MBOMIncludedMaterial.description: Associates an MBOM with material entities specifically required, consumed, substituted, or operationally utilized during manufacturing execution processes associated with the manufacturing bill of materials.

isUsedByProductionPlan.description: Indicates that an MBOM is utilized by a ProductionPlan for manufacturing planning and operational organization. Associates an MBOM with one or more ProductionPlan entities that utilize the manufacturing bill of materials to coordinate production activities, process organization, resource planning, and manufacturing execution preparation.

derivationLogic.description: Describes the rule, condition, or logic used to derive the event (e.g., threshold rule, CEP query, prediction model). For example: "argonGasLevel < 20%"

affectsProcess.description: Indicates the production process whose performance or execution is impacted by the event

occursDuringExecution.description: Associates the event with the specific execution instance of a production process.

parameterID.description: Unique identifier for the measurable parameter used to ensure traceability and consistent reference across sensors, observations, and analytics tools.

parameterName.description: Human-readable name describing the measured parameter (e.g., Temperature, CycleTime, EnergyConsumption).

parameterDescription.description: Optional textual description explaining the meaning and role of the parameter within the manufacturing system.

unitOfMeasurement.description: Specifies the measurement unit associated with the parameter (e.g., °C, mm/s, seconds, kWh). This helps interpret observed values generated by sensors.

hasProductName.description: Name or label of the product

hasProductFamily.description: Type of the Product,e.g. Finished product. Other enumerated values need to be defined

hasEcoLabel.description: Any eco label or mark visible to consumer. If you want to record customer-facing sustainability marks.

isProducedByLeadManufacturer.description: Indicates the LeadManufacturer responsible for producing or assembling a specific ProductType within the manufacturing network.

hasBOM.description: Each product has one Bill of Materials

isIncludedInSalesOrder.description: Indicates the sales orders in which a product type is requested. Associates a ProductType with one or more SalesOrder entities in which the product type has been requested or ordered by a customer.

productIsCertifiedBy.description: Associates a product type with certifications, standards, or compliance approvals applicable to the product definition. Links a ProductType to one or more Certification entities representing regulatory approvals, compliance standards, quality certifications, sustainability labels, or industry accreditations associated with the product type.

productHasMaterialKPI.description: Associates a product type with material-related sustainability or resource performance indicators. Links a ProductType to one or more MaterialKPI entities representing material-related performance, sustainability, efficiency, recyclability, or resource utilization indicators associated with the product design or material composition.

hasManufacturedProduct.description: Associates a ProductType with one or more ManufacturedProduct entities that represent physical manufactured realizations of the product definition.

hasSustainabilityReportLink.description: URL or document reference to sustainability report.

stationDescription.description: Short description of what the station does

stationName.description: Name of the station (e.g., Cutting Station)

monitoredByStationSensor.description: InverseOf isDeployedOnStation:Represents the capability of the production monitoring sensor to detect production-related events such as bottlenecks or performance degradation. In practice these events are derived from sensor observations.

supportsProcess.description: Associates a Station with one or more ProductionProcess entities that can be operationally performed or supported at the station. Links a Station to one or more ProductionProcess entities that the station is configured, equipped, or operationally capable of supporting within the manufacturing environment.

stationLocatedInFactory.description: InverseOf factoryHasStation :Specifies the production or assembly stations located within the factory. Stations represent operational work areas where specific manufacturing tasks are performed.

hasSpecificationName.description: Name/title of the spec (e.g., "Technical Drawing A1")

hasSpecificationDetail.description: Free text or JSON describing the spec

hasDocumentLink.description: Link to the document file (PDF, etc.)

hasSpecValidUntil.description: Optional expiry date for the spec

hasSpecifiedMaterialGrade.description: Specifies the quality grade, classification, or industrial standard associated with the material used in the product or component.

hasSpecifiedMaterialType.description: Specifies the category or type of material used in the product or component, such as wood, steel, plastic, aluminum, or composite material.

hasSpecifiedMaterialOrigin.description: Specifies the geographical, supplier, or source origin of the material used in the product or component.

hasMaterialCertification.description: Links a MaterialSpecification to one or more Certification entities that validate the material’s compliance with quality, sustainability, safety, or regulatory standards.

referencesMaterial.description: Technical specs often depend on material properties and constraints.

hasLaborRole.description: the Labor role of the employee

createsWorkOrder.description: Associates an Employee with one or more WorkOrder entities that the employee created, initiated, or registered as part of manufacturing planning or operational management activities.

componentName.description: Unique identifier for tracking and referencing.

componentWeight.description: Weight of the component (for logistics, cost).

componentID.description: The name of the component (e.g., CutWoodPanel, CotFrame).

componentDescription.description: Short description of the component or its purpose.

isProducedByExecution.description: Indicates the ProcessExecution responsible for producing a manufactured component during runtime manufacturing operations. Associates a ManufacturedComponent with the ProcessExecution during which the component was produced, assembled, transformed, or generated as part of manufacturing operations.

isConsumedAsComponentInputByExecution.description: Associates a ManufacturedComponent with one or more ProcessExecution entities in which the component is consumed, assembled, transformed, or utilized as an intermediate manufacturing input.

isInputToProcess.description: The product process the component requires

isOutputOfProcess.description: The process that produces this component/semi-final product

isIncludedInBOM.description: Indicates the bill of materials in which a component is included. Associates a ProductComponent with one or more BillOfMaterials entities in which the component is included as part of the product structure or manufacturing composition.

componentIsStoredIn.description: components, including semi-finished and finished products are stored in a Warehouse

roleDescription.description: Short description of the role’s responsibilities.

isCriticalForProcess.description: Flag to indicate if this role is critical for production bottlenecks or key operations.

roleName.description: Name of the labor role (e.g., Assembler, Painter, Inspector).

parameterID.description: Unique identifier for the measurable parameter used to ensure traceability and consistent reference across sensors, observations, and analytics tools.

parameterName.description: Human-readable name describing the measured parameter (e.g., Temperature, CycleTime, EnergyConsumption).

parameterDescription.description: Optional textual description explaining the meaning and role of the parameter within the manufacturing system.

unitOfMeasurement.description: Specifies the measurement unit associated with the parameter (e.g., °C, mm/s, seconds, kWh). This helps interpret observed values generated by sensors.

enviroParamMonitoredBy.description: inverse of moitorsEnviroParam: Specifies which measurable property is being observed (e.g., CycleTime, Temperature). Prevents ambiguity.

hasEscalationProcedure.description: Describes the procedure if SLA terms are violated.

hasProductReturnPolicy.description: Defines the return terms (e.g., "Return within 14 days with full refund").

hasPenaltyClause.description: Description of penalties for SLA violation

governsSalesOrder.description: Associates a service-level agreement with the sales orders it governs. Associates a ServiceLevelAgreement with one or more SalesOrder entities whose production, delivery, fulfillment, or service obligations are governed by the agreement.

governsFulfillmentOf.description: Indicates that the SLA applies to a specific product or customized order. Associates a ServiceLevelAgreement with one or more ManufacturedProduct entities whose production or fulfillment activities are governed by the agreement.

isExecutionSustainabilityOf.description: Indicates that a Sustainability entity describes or evaluates the environmental and resource-related performance of a specific ProcessExecution. Associates a Sustainability entity with a ProcessExecution whose runtime manufacturing activities, environmental impact, resource usage, emissions, waste generation, or operational sustainability performance are being monitored or evaluated.

hasSustainCertification.description: Sustainability or traceability certification reference, for example FSC-C123456

isInputToEnergyKPI.description: Indicates that a ProcessSustainability instance contributes data used in the calculation of a specific EnergyKPI.

receivesDataFrom.description: InverseOf reportsToSustainability: Indicates that the environmental sensor provides environmental monitoring data used by the SustainabilityBlueprint for sustainability analysis and environmental impact assessment.

hasSustainabilityReportLink.description: URL or document reference to sustainability report.

derivationLogic.description: Describes the rule, condition, or logic used to derive the event (e.g., threshold rule, CEP query, prediction model). For example: "argonGasLevel < 20%"

observationID.description: Unique identifier of the observation instance. Required for traceability and linking with external systems (e.g., FDIF, SQL logs).

observationTimestamp.description: The exact timestamp when the measurement was taken. Critical for temporal reasoning and event derivation.

unitOfMeasureSensor.description: The measurement unit of the observed value (e.g., °C, mm/s, seconds, kWh). Keeps observation self-contained for interoperability.

dataSourceReference.description: Optional reference to raw source (e.g., MQTT topic, CFX message ID, database row). Supports traceability to FDIF layer.

isObservationOfEvent.description: Inverse of hasObservation : Links the event to the underlying observation containing the measured data.

conditionObservedBy.description: inverse Of onservesCondition: Links the observation to the sensor that produced it. Ensures traceability and correct semantic chain.

triggersMaintenanceEvent.description: Connects observation to derived Event. This is where external reasoning may instantiate Event instances.

hasMaterialSustainDataSource.description: Origin or system providing the sustainability data

linkedToLCARecord.description: reference to Life Cycle Assessment dataset

hasMaterialSustainabilityID.description: Unique identifier for the sustainability record

hasSustainCertification.description: Sustainability or traceability certification reference, for example FSC-C123456

isAggregatedByCompSustain.description: inverse of compSustainAggregates: ComponentSustainabilty aggregates all involved material sustainability metrics

machineAffectedByEvent.description: Inverse of affectsMachine:Identifies the machine affected by the maintenance-related event, such as equipment degradation, failure risk, or maintenance requirement.

isUsedByExecution.description: Links to a specific process run (instance)

capableOfProcess.description: Machine operates on a Production Process

monitoredByConditionSensor.description: Inverse of isDeployedOnMachone: Indicates the specific machine where the condition monitoring sensor is installed. Each sensor is deployed on exactly one machine.

isMaintainedBy.description: Machine is maintained by an Employee, e.g., Operator

monitoredByProdSensor.description: InverseOf isDeployedOnMachine: Indicates that the sensor may be physically installed on a machine performing the monitored production process.

isReservedByPlan.description: Associates a Machine with one or more ProductionPlan entities that reserve or allocate the machine for planned manufacturing operations or production activities.

hasProductionDate.description: Date on which the manufactured product was produced or completed.

hasManufacturedProductExpiryDate.description: Expiration or end-of-validity date associated with the manufactured product, when applicable.

hasBatchNumber.description: Identifier of the production batch to which the manufactured product belongs.

hasManufacturedProductID.description: Unique identifier assigned to the manufactured product instance or production batch.

hasSerialNumber.description: Serial number assigned to the manufactured product for traceability and lifecycle management.

isStoredIn.description: the Warehouse where the Manufactured Product is stored in

producedAtFactory.description: Links a ManufacturedProduct to the Factory where the product was physically produced, assembled, or finalized. This relationship supports factory-level traceability, Digital Product Passport reporting, enterprise manufacturing analytics, and product-site lineage navigation across distributed manufacturing environments.

hasAllocatedEnergyKPI.description:
The object property hasAllocatedEnergyKPI indicates that a Product is associated with one or more EnergyKPI instances whose values have been allocated to it.

It allows querying and aggregating all energy-related KPIs contributing to the sustainability profile of a product.

isInstanceOfProductType.description: Associates a ManufacturedProduct with the ProductType that defines its design, specifications, bill of materials, and production-related characteristics.

hasLogisticsKPI.description: inverse of allocatedToProduct :Links a LogisticsKPI to a Product, indicating that transportation-related impacts have been allocated to the product.

hasAllocatedWasteKPI.description: Indicates that a Product is associated with one or more WasteKPIs whose values have been allocated to it, contributing to its overall waste-related sustainability profile.

isPartOfSalesOrder.description: the manufactured product fulfills or belongs to a specific sales order.

fulfilledUnderSLA.description: Associates a manufactured product with the SLA under which it is fulfilled. Links a ManufacturedProduct to the ServiceLevelAgreement under which its manufacturing, delivery, or fulfillment obligations are managed.

hasAllocatedWaterKPI.description: Indicates that a Product is associated with one or more WaterKPIs whose values have been allocated to it, contributing to its overall water-related sustainability profile.

isDeployedOnShipment.description: Indicates the shipment on which the logistics sensor is installed or associated, enabling tracking of shipment conditions during transportation.

observesLogistics.description: Links the observation to the sensor that produced it. Ensures traceability and correct semantic chain.

monitorsLogisticsParam.description: Specifies which measurable property is being observed (e.g., CycleTime, Temperature).

waterKPIEvaluatesProcess.description: Links a WaterKPI to the ProductionProcess it assesses, indicating that the KPI quantifies the water-related performance (e.g., consumption or wastewater generation) of that process.

WaterKPIAllocatedToProduct.description: Links a WaterKPI to a Product, indicating that the water-related impact measured at process level has been allocated to the product based on a defined allocation approach.

hasCountry.description: Country where the supplier is based

hasStartDate.description: Date when the supplier relationship started

hasSupplierType.description: Defines an operational or business classification associated with the Supplier, such as logistics provider, maintenance provider, energy supplier, or service provider. This property complements the supplier hierarchy and supports organizational categorization and filtering.

locatedAt.description: Geographical location of the supplier (if you model Location as a class)

benchmarkSource.description: Specifies the origin of the benchmark value, such as a standard (e.g., ISO), industry guideline, or authoritative dataset.

isBenchmarkOf.description: Links a KPIBenchmark to the KPI it refers to, indicating that the benchmark value is defined for evaluating the performance of that specific KPI.

componentName.description: Unique identifier for tracking and referencing.

componentWeight.description: Weight of the component (for logistics, cost).

componentID.description: The name of the component (e.g., CutWoodPanel, CotFrame).

componentDescription.description: Short description of the component or its purpose.

isIncludedInBOM.description: Indicates the bill of materials in which a component is included. Associates a ProductComponent with one or more BillOfMaterials entities in which the component is included as part of the product structure or manufacturing composition.

componentIsStoredIn.description: components, including semi-finished and finished products are stored in a Warehouse

transportMode.description: Specifies the mode of transportation used (e.g., road, rail, sea, air), influencing the environmental impact of shipment

evaluatesShipment.description: Links a LogisticsKPI to the Shipment it assesses, indicating that the KPI quantifies the environmental impact of a specific transportation activity.

logisticsKPIAllocatedToProduct.description: Links a LogisticsKPI to a Product, indicating that transportation-related impacts have been allocated to the product.

observesCondition.description: Links the observation to the sensor that produced it. Ensures traceability and correct semantic chain.

monitorsProdMetric.description: Specifies which measurable property is being observed (e.g., CycleTime, Temperature). Prevents ambiguity.

isDeployedOnMachineProductionSensor.description: Indicates that the sensor may be physically installed on a machine performing the monitored production process.

observesProduction.description: Links the observation to the sensor that produced it. Ensures traceability and correct semantic chain.

monitorsProcess.description: Indicates the production process whose performance is monitored by the sensor. Enables linking observed production metrics with the relevant process.

isDeployedOnStation.description: Represents the capability of the production monitoring sensor to detect production-related events such as bottlenecks or performance degradation. In practice these events are derived from sensor observations.

affectsMachine.description: Identifies the machine affected by the maintenance-related event, such as equipment degradation, failure risk, or maintenance requirement.

maintenanceEventTriggeredBy.description: inverseOf triggersMaintenanceEvent: Connects observation to derived Event. This is where external reasoning may instantiate Event instances.

scheduledInPlan.description: Associates an Event with the ProductionPlan in which the event is scheduled, coordinated, or integrated as part of manufacturing planning and operational activities.

isMaterialKPIOfProductType.description: Associates a MaterialKPI with one or more ProductType entities whose material composition or design characteristics are evaluated through the KPI.

metricDescription.description: Explains what the metric measures. For example:Measures the percentage of on-time deliveries per week

metricOwner.description: Role or party responsible for monitoring the metric, for exampe: "Quality and Logistics Department"

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit associated with the metric, for example: days

kpiDefinition.description: Formula or method used to compute metric. For example: "DeliveryAccuracy = (OnTimeDeliveries / TotalDeliveries) × 100"

eventID.description: Unique identifier assigned to the event for traceability across systems and services.

eventDescription.description: Human-readable description providing contextual details about the event.

hasSource.description:
Identifies the specific origin of the event as a textual identifier, such as a sensor ID, machine ID, system name, or external source. This property enables traceability to the originating component without requiring explicit semantic linking.
Constraint: The value of hasSource should follow a structured identifier format combining the source type and a unique identifier (e.g., Machine_3, Sensor_12, CEP_Engine_1).

eventTimestamp.description: The time at which the event occurred or was detected.

violatesStipulation.description: Indicates that a detected operational event (e.g., delivery delay, production bottleneck, or quality issue) results in the violation of a specific SLA stipulation defined in an SLA agreement. This property connects the operational event monitoring layer with the SLA governance layer, enabling the system to identify contractual breaches caused by operational disruptions.

requiresAction.description: Indicates that the event requires an operational or decision-making response (e.g., maintenance, rescheduling, rerouting).

leadsToEvent.description: Inverse of derivedFromEvent: Indicates that an event is derived or inferred from one or more other events (e.g., CEP-generated composite events).

hasObservation.description: Links the event to the underlying observation containing the measured data.

affectsEntity.description: Specifies the entity impacted by the event, such as a machine, production process, station, product, or supplier.

triggersEvaluation.description: Inverse of triggeredByEvent: Links a KPIEvaluation to the Event that triggered its execution, capturing the temporal or operational cause of the evaluation.

affectsKPI.description: Links an event to one or more KPIs that are impacted, enabling performance evaluation and monitoring.

processInstruction.description: Specifies planning-level operational instructions, guidelines, or manufacturing directives associated with the execution of a ProductionPlan. Defines planning-level manufacturing instructions, operational guidelines, sequencing notes, or execution directives associated with a ProductionPlan to support the coordination, scheduling, and organization of manufacturing activities.

plannedStartDate.description: Defines when the plan is scheduled to start; used for scheduling and lead time analysis.

plannedEndDate.description: Defines when the plan is scheduled to finish; helps calculate planned cycle time.

organizesWordOrder.description: Associates a ProductionPlan with the WorkOrder entities coordinated and scheduled for manufacturing execution. Links a ProductionPlan to one or more WorkOrder entities that are coordinated, scheduled, or operationally organized to execute planned manufacturing activities and production operations.

usesMBOM.description: Associates a ProductionPlan with the Manufacturing Bill of Materials (MBOM) used to organize and execute manufacturing operations. Links a ProductionPlan to one or more MBOM entities that define the manufacturing-oriented product structure, materials, components, and process-specific manufacturing configurations used for production planning and operational execution.

organizesProcess.description: Associates a ProductionPlan with the ProductionProcess entities coordinated and arranged for manufacturing execution. Links a ProductionPlan to one or more ProductionProcess entities that are scheduled, coordinated, sequenced, or operationally organized as part of the manufacturing planning and production workflow.

reservesMachine.description: Associates a ProductionPlan with one or more Machine entities reserved or allocated to support planned manufacturing operations, production scheduling, or process execution activities.

planIncludesEvent.description: Associates a ProductionPlan with one or more Event entities representing scheduled maintenance, inspection, operational, or production-related events coordinated within the manufacturing planning process.

allocatedToProduct.description:
The object property allocatedToProduct links an EnergyKPI instance to a Product, indicating that the KPI value has been assigned or distributed to that product based on a defined allocation logic.

This property is used when energy-related impacts (e.g., energy consumption or carbon footprint) originate at the process level but must be attributed to individual products, typically using allocation rules such as mass-based, time-based, or economic allocation.

It enables:

product-level sustainability assessment derived from process data
lifecycle-based impact distribution (LCA-aligned)
traceability of how process impacts contribute to product KPIs

hasEnergyShareInput.description:
The object property hasInput links an EnergyKPI instance to the corresponding ProcessSustainability instance(s) that provide the underlying raw data used for its computation.

It represents the dependency of a KPI on observed or reported sustainability metrics, such as energy consumption, renewable energy share, and emission factors, captured at the process level.

This relationship enables:

traceability between KPI values and their source data
transparency in KPI computation
support for semantic reasoning and validation

evaluatesProcess.description:
The object property evaluatesProcess links an EnergyKPI instance to the specific ProductionProcess it assesses, indicating that the KPI quantifies the energy-related performance of that process.

It captures the evaluation relationship between a performance indicator and the operational entity being analyzed. Through this property, KPIs are explicitly tied to the processes whose sustainability performance they measure.

This enables:

contextualization of KPIs within manufacturing operations
process-level performance monitoring and comparison
semantic
